claim_boundary: Finite public-synthetic engineering result. The selected relation stream and one-unit schedule reduce deterministic collection work and same-host wall/core cost. The scalar-blind median crosses same-target rho in whole-process wall, but IC remains much dearer in total core-seconds. This is not a SOTA, asymptotic, key-recovery, production-curve, Magma-complete, or externally reproduced result.

host.resource_meter: process CPU seconds and peak RSS reported by ic workflow

instance.factor_base: algebraic subgroup-orbit specification, factor-base seed 1, 36000 requested points

selection.scope: Target-independent deterministic relation rank and through-logs resource screen. No target solve or rho timing entered the seed choice.

selected.reason: Seeds 6, 8 and 9 were complete at 17000 after all candidates failed at 16000; seed 6 had the lowest measured process CPU among the complete 17000-probe candidates.

resource_envelope.accounting: Target-independent parameter selection is not hidden in the selected operational run. Charge this envelope once when treating seed 6 and the 17k budget as newly discovered for a first-ever target; amortize it only across explicitly counted later targets.

change.why: A target-independent public seed screen found a relation stream that determines all 344 orbit columns with 9000 fewer walked probes. Both arms retain in-process trial parallelism and one relation artifact.

matched_same_host_ab.correctness: 32 of 32 targets verified in every arm; both arms used the same algebraic base, target seeds, solver, table tier, and binary.

public_unknown_scalar.core_cost_reading: IC-only total core-seconds are measured directly. The one-target rho is single-threaded, but its process CPU was not sampled as a separate report field; the whole-process wall crossover is not a core-second crossover.

forced_single_core.control: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1; the measured wall/core ratio verifies that the relation collector did not spend parallel CPU behind the one-thread label.
forced_single_core.reading: The scalar-blind one-target run loses to automorphism rho after full precompute on one core. The 32-target batch crosses in wall and total core because the same precompute is amortized. Neither result is an asymptotic or SOTA claim.

thread_count_diagnostic.reading: This is a one-pass diagnostic on the scalar-blind target, not an independent selection panel. The default 14 logical-thread run remains the operational profile; lower thread counts reduce concurrency but do not create a one-target core-second crossover.

parameter_selection_envelope.accounting: Target-independent parameter selection is not hidden in the selected operational run. Charge this envelope once when treating seed 6 and the 17k budget as newly discovered for a first-ever target; amortize it only across explicitly counted later targets.

single_target_primary_accounting.scope: The operational run charges algebraic factor-base materialization, pair-table predicate construction, relation collection, verification, sparse linear algebra, descent, memory and process CPU. The separate selection envelope charges the research-time search that fixed relation seed 6 and the 17k budget.

factor_base_width.reading: The adjacent complete 38k and 40k arms used more process CPU; narrower and 44k trial budgets were already comparable or dearer before reaching rank.

collection_window.reading: The complete 768 and 2048 controls used more CPU. The 1536 control did not reach rank at a slightly larger scan budget.

science_process_accounting.scope: All retained target-independent seed/rank selection, matched predecessor controls, parallel and single-core scalar-blind repetitions, independent holdouts, thread-count, width and window diagnostics, and accepted or rejected single-target build-cache, prefetch, canonicalization-lane, projected-predicate-reuse, orbit-derived-projection and cutoff A/B processes. Compiler/test time and rho-free JSON inspection are not scientific runs and are not included.
science_process_accounting.interpretation: This campaign envelope is research evidence cost, not the cost of one fixed-parameter operational invocation. It is retained so unsuccessful searches and rejected implementations are not hidden.

current_head_selection_cost_replay.reading: The workflow now emits native subgroup-orbit construction counts on fresh and resumed materialization. Timing already charged selection wall and process resources; these counters expose what that phase did without changing the base or solver.

current_head_phase_resource_replay.reading: Stage CPU deltas reconcile to the top-level process total. Collection now separates pair-table construction from the relation unit; RSS fields remain cumulative process high-water marks, not phase-local allocation peaks or deltas.

single_target_folded_pair_build_cache.scope: one public-hash unknown-scalar n=53 target; factor base and relation stream remain target independent
single_target_folded_pair_build_cache.mechanism: The first folded-table pass caches only a six-byte (bucket, rest/filter payload) token per stored pair. The scatter pass consumes that token instead of recomputing every batched group addition, canonical key and hash. Shapes needing more than 48 token bits retain the previous exact recomputation path.

matched_current_head_ab.reading: The selected cache wins pair-build wall and CPU in 5/5 pairs, IC wall in 5/5 and whole-process CPU in 5/5. Median peak RSS rises because the temporary is charged while the final table is allocated.

uncompressed_per_row_hash_cache.decision: rejected_excessive_peak_memory; motivated the packed flat token cache

five_byte_token_with_changed_presence_in.decision: rejected_relation_scan_regression; selected cache preserves the original filter index

matched_one_core_ab.reading: With one Rayon worker the eliminated second arithmetic pass is fully exposed: pair-build CPU and wall are approximately halved, IC wall falls 15.9% and whole-process CPU falls 12.5%. The candidate remains slower than same-process rho: median rho/IC is 0.2229, or IC/rho about 4.49.

single_target_folded_pair_build_cache.claim_boundary: A measured one-instance engineering speedup with an explicit memory trade. It does not change the seven-gate SOTA verdict, asymptotic exponent, missing licensed Magma comparison or missing independent review.

single_target_aarch64_filter_prefetch.mechanism: Issue the native non-faulting PRFM PLDL1KEEP hint for the presence-filter address already selected by the 32-key lookahead. x86_64 retains its existing _mm_prefetch path and other architectures retain the no-op fallback.

matched_one_core_ab.reading: The native hint wins relation-unit wall and CPU in 5/5 one-core pairs. The resulting full-process change is small: IC wall wins 4/5 and whole-process CPU wins 4/5; peak RSS is unchanged within noise.

single_target_aarch64_filter_prefetch.claim_boundary: An AArch64-specific constant-factor engineering improvement on one public-synthetic target. It changes no algorithm, relation, exponent, solver gate or SOTA verdict.

single_target_laned_frobenius_canonicali.mechanism: Canonicalize folded-table abscissae eight points at a time. Each scalar key is a 52-step dependent rotation chain at n=53; interleaving eight independent chains exposes instruction-level parallelism while preserving the exact normal-basis minimum rotation.

matched_one_core_ab.reading: Eight interleaved rotation chains win relation-unit wall and CPU, full IC wall and whole-process CPU in all five one-core pairs, with flat memory.

matched_default_thread_ab.reading: At the host default thread count the relation unit wins all five pairs; full IC wall and whole-process CPU also win all five, while whole wall wins four of five because the single-thread rho phase dominates process variance.

validation: direct batched-versus-scalar key equality on degrees 8, 12, 16, 20, 23, 31, 53, 61 including infinity
identical 588-relation hash and verified scalar in every matched run
single_target_laned_frobenius_canonicali.claim_boundary: A constant-factor implementation improvement on one public-synthetic target. It changes no factor base, relation, solver, asymptotic exponent or SOTA gate.

single_target_projected_predicate_reuse.mechanism: Construct the public cofactor-projected signed-Frobenius factor-base predicate once in selection, keep it bound to its curve and factor base, and reuse exact clones for relation linear algebra and individual-log descent. Selection retains the full construction charge; logs and solve no longer repeat it.
single_target_projected_predicate_reuse.known_log_boundary: The context contains only projected points and algebraic orbit locations. It contains no factor-base logarithms; those remain derived from collected relations and certified separately.

matched_one_core_ab.reading: Selection remains unchanged because it still constructs and charges the algebraic projected predicate once. Reusing that exact map cuts logs and solve setup, producing 5/5 IC-wall and whole-CPU wins with slightly lower RSS.

matched_default_thread_ab.reading: Default-thread selection is unchanged, while logs and solve CPU collapse because the predicate is cloned rather than rebuilt. Whole wall, whole CPU and IC wall win all five pairs with flat RSS.

validation: shared and freshly rebuilt projected contexts expose the same column count
shared and fresh individual-log solvers recover the same scalar and trial count
identical 588-relation hash and verified scalar in every matched run
single_target_projected_predicate_reuse.claim_boundary: A full-cost constant-factor implementation improvement on one public-synthetic target. Predicate construction remains charged once; the asymptotic exponent and SOTA gates are unchanged.

single_target_orbit_derived_projection.mechanism: Cofactor projection commutes with Frobenius and negation. Project one representative of each already certified signed factor-base orbit, then derive all 36,464 projected points from their public (orbit, shift, sign) coordinates. Canonical projected-orbit merging remains exact and unchanged.

matched_one_core_ab.reading: Projecting one representative per signed orbit cuts the charged selection predicate to about 21% of its prior one-core wall and CPU. Full IC wall and whole-process CPU win all five pairs with flat memory.

matched_default_thread_ab.reading: At default threads selection CPU falls to about 19% and wall to about 70% because the previous all-point projection parallelised. Full IC wall and whole-process CPU win all five pairs; RSS is lower in all five.

validation: fast orbit-derived projection agrees point-for-point with an independent all-point general-arithmetic map on subgroup bases at n=15, 19, 31, 37 and the algebraic n=41 union base
identical 588-relation hash and verified scalar in every matched run
predicate native counts emitted in both factor-base summary and selection stage
single_target_orbit_derived_projection.claim_boundary: A charged algebraic-predicate construction improvement on one public-synthetic target. It uses no target subgroup enumeration or logarithm labels and changes no asymptotic exponent or SOTA gate.

single_target_fixed_width_key_chunks.mechanism: Process every complete eight-point normal-basis canonicalization chunk with a compile-time fixed lane count and handle only the final remainder scalarly. This removes the dynamic chunk length from the hot rotation loop and gives LLVM a constant trip count.

matched_one_core_ab.reading: Fixed eight-lane chunks win relation-unit wall and CPU, full IC wall and whole-process CPU in all five one-core pairs. Median RSS rises 0.4%.

matched_default_thread_ab.reading: At default threads relation-unit wall and CPU and full IC wall win all five pairs; whole-process CPU wins four of five. Median RSS rises 1.8%.

validation: direct fixed-lane versus scalar canonical-key equality across degrees 8, 12, 16, 20, 23, 31, 53 and 61 including infinity
identical 588-relation hash and verified scalar in every matched run
single_target_fixed_width_key_chunks.claim_boundary: A small constant-factor implementation improvement on one public-synthetic target. It changes no mathematics, factor base, relation, exponent or SOTA gate.
